Phrasing-tag membership set — built once from the token map.

(module scope)

The description record — components.animations..

record

Reads one animation record from the live-then-fallback components dictionary. Unknown ids yield empty strings — applying them is a no-op, so callers never need a pre-check.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns {alt, longdesc} — possibly empty strings.

animationAlt

The one-sentence animation label — the alt-equivalent record field.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns The localized alt text, or ''.

animationLongDesc

The full animation description — element, behavior, triggers, tech and purpose in one paragraph.

  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @returns The localized longdesc text, or ''.

ensureDescNode

Finds-or-creates the longdesc node inside root and refreshes its text — locale switches land as text updates on the same node, so crawlers always read the active locale. The node anchors as the element's own sibling so it inherits whatever landmark wraps the element. Elements with no element parent (detached or direct shadow-root children) and document-level surfaces (the body, whose <html> parent can't take a sibling) fall back to the root / <main> / body hosts.

  • @param root The element's root (ShadowRoot for the closed DOM tree,
  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry.
  • @param text The longdesc text to store.
  • @param el The animated element — sibling anchor for the node.
  • @returns The desc node id, or '' when the text is empty / the root

applyAnimationDesc

Places an animated element's translated description into the DOM — a crawler-only <span class="sr-only" aria-hidden="true"> sibling node carrying the longdesc. No ARIA wiring and no canvas fallback text: the element's own accessibility is left untouched (inner text on a labelled canvas would mismatch its accessible name — the Label-in-Name failure).

Safe to call on every mount/locale-change: the desc node is created once per (root, id) and only re-texted afterwards. Elements without a resolvable description are left untouched.

  • @param el The animated element (any Element — canvas, img, div, button…).
  • @param id ANIMATION_IDS entry naming its animation.
